ValidationRule.description: Error when Chronicle is quoted without Threat Response on an account that does not have Threat Response.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(SBQQ__Product__r.Product_Line__c, "Chronicle") && NOT(CONTAINS(00N0e000003CSjF.00N0e000003CSyt.00N0e000002k4zF, "Tanium Threat Response") || SBQQ__Quote__r.TaniumThreatResponseDef__c > 0) && NOT($Profile.Name="Super User") && NOT($Profile.Name ="Tanium System Admin") && NOT($Profile.Name ="System Administrator") && NOT($Profile.Name ="Tanium Deals Desk")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You have added Chronicle for Tanium Threat Response on an Account that does not have Threat Response. Please add Threat Response on the Quote to proceed.
